answer: Work waits on the tide until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the mesa of the next round. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. By the forge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
